The structure of K2FeAs3 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms—K8Fe4As12—distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Fe and As centers, each with six geometric neighbors; Fe is surrounded by six As, while As has four Fe and two K neighbors. K centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 neighbors. Corner-sharing between Fe and As octahedra and face-sharing between As octahedra are observed. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
